highlights.title: Custom Transmission Buffer
highlights.description: Configurable transmission buffer sizing for optimal USB DAC throughput and stutter-free audio streaming.

highlights.title: Focus Lyrics View
highlights.description: New focused lyrics mode with dynamic centering and distraction-free typography for Modern layout.

highlights.title: Custom Resampling Target
highlights.description: High-grade native resampling options with customizable target frequencies or bit-perfect passthrough.

highlights.title: Playlist Sorting
highlights.description: Sort tracks in any playlist by title, artist, album, date added, or custom order.

highlights.title: Lock Volume
highlights.description: Freeze and lock hardware volume levels to protect DAC line-out signals and prevent unexpected jumps.

highlights.title: Liquid Glass & Visual Polish
highlights.description: Optimized optical refraction, matched corner radii, smoother backdrop transitions, and UI stabilization.

highlights.title: Performance Profiling & Diagnostics
highlights.description: Real-time frame timing diagnostics, audio log watcher, and one-tap performance report exports.

highlights.title: Bug Fixes & Refinements
highlights.description: Fixed AAC tag reading, sleep timer on repeat mode, 24-bit Hi-Res audio playback, and Audio Lab analysis.
